name: Cholesterol homeostasis via SREBP-regulated biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern cellular sterol/cholesterol balance; unlike the LDL-receptor clearance and LXR/HDL efflux neighbours, this theme carries SREBP signalling and regulation of cholesterol biosynthesis.

name: Stromal matrix with complement and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members describe fibroblast/stromal matrix, adhesion and secreted factors; distinct from EMT/collagen/KRAS and perivascular-endothelial neighbours by its complement modules and mast cell/macrophage chemotaxis and TGFB1 production.

core: Cytosolic RNA sensing inducing type I interferon
name: RIG-I-like RNA sensing driving type I interferon production
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5, dsRNA and TLR7/8/9-IRF7 sensing leading to IFN-alpha/beta induction; neighbours add virus-specific evasion, OAS effectors, TBK1 regulation or cytosolic DNA sensing.

core: Lipid mediator GPCR signaling in inflammation
name: Cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis and lipid mediator GPCRs
rationale: Members center on leukotriene (LTC4/LTD4) synthesis, transport and CysLT receptors with prostanoid and PAF signalling via GPCRs; neighbours instead hold lipoxin/HETE catabolism, histamine, or COX prostaglandin synthesis.

qualifier: nodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion and axonal node assembly
rationale: Members are L1-family, nectin, DSCAM and SDK neuronal adhesion interactions plus paranodal junction and sodium channel clustering; neighbours carry L1 signalling/recycling, ephrin repulsion or myelination instead.

core: Ephrin and L1/NCAM signaling in neurite remodeling
qualifier: growth cone collapse, synapse pruning and fasciculation
name: Ephrin repulsion and L1/NCAM signaling in neurite remodeling
rationale: Members combine Eph-ephrin repulsion, L1/NCAM/CHL1 signalling, axon fasciculation and dendrite/synapse remodeling; neighbours instead emphasize adhesion, DCC/netrin attraction, RAC1 or Sema3A guidance.

core: Dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
qualifier: T cell costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
name: Dendritic cell and T cell surface costimulation
rationale: Members are DC and T cell surface signatures with regulation of T cell costimulation and DC differentiation; neighbours are NK/cytotoxic, monocyte, MHC-II presentation or B cell themes.

qualifier: p53 transcriptional control and apoptosome activation
name: p53-driven mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis and apoptosome activation
rationale: Members cover BH3-only/BAX/BAK activation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome/SMAC and p53-regulated intrinsic apoptosis; neighbours cover execution-phase DNA fragmentation, p53 cell-cycle arrest or senescence.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and restriction of viral replication
name: Interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors restricting viral replication
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha response/ISG signatures, ISG15 and host restriction of viral replication, release and life cycle; neighbours are the upstream RIG-I/IRF3 sensing and interferon-induction pathways.

core: Negative regulation of skeletal muscle development
name: Satellite cell maintenance restraining skeletal muscle development
rationale: Members concern satellite cell maintenance and restraint of muscle tissue development and proliferation; neighbours are myoblast commitment, fusion, proliferation and atrophy themes.

name: Mast cell differentiation and degranulation control
rationale: All members regulate mast cell differentiation, activation, degranulation or histamine release; neighbours carry FcεRI signalling cascades or eosinophil/Th2 biology.

name: IL-10, IL-12/23 and IL-15/21 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-15 and IL-21 with NK cell regulation; neighbours instead hold IL-2/IL-7, IL-27/35, NFkB myeloid activation or interferon/NKT responses.

qualifier: elastic fibre and collagen fibril assembly
name: Elastic fibre and collagen fibril matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM modules plus elastic fibre assembly and collagen fibril organization; neighbours emphasize collagen degradation/MMPs, fibronectin-integrin matrix or collagen biosynthesis/crosslinking.

qualifier: proliferation, apoptosis and positive selection in thymus
name: Thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection
rationale: All members regulate thymic T cell proliferation, apoptosis, differentiation or selection; neighbours concern bone marrow hematopoietic stem/progenitor and B cell homeostasis.

qualifier: NAD salvage and nucleoside phosphate interconversion
name: NAD salvage and nucleoside phosphate interconversion
rationale: Most members concern nicotinate/NAD(P) metabolism and nucleotide di-/triphosphate interconversion; neighbours instead carry creatine, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport or coenzyme A biosynthesis.

name: Epithelial SLC26/SLC4 anion exchange and aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members are chloride/bicarbonate/sulfate/iodide exchangers, CFTR and their disease defects plus aquaporin and paracellular water transport; neighbours instead hold cation-chloride cotransporters, Na+/H+ exchangers or carbonic anhydrase pH control.

qualifier: p75 neurotrophin receptor growth and RhoA inhibitory signaling
name: Injured axon regeneration regulated by p75NTR signaling
rationale: Members cover injured-axon sprouting and neuron projection regeneration with p75NTR-linked growth stimulation, RhoA inhibition and ceramide signalling; neighbours concern collateral sprouting without injury, Sema3A or myelination.

qualifier: clathrin coat cycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle and receptor endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are synaptic vesicle endocytosis/recycling, clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and neurotransmitter receptor internalization; neighbours carry presynaptic cytoskeleton, vesicle clustering and secretion control.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signaling in stress responses
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signalling and dense core vesicle release with stress, CRH, corticosterone, fear and drinking/ethanol behaviours; neighbours instead hold mating/aggressive behaviour or orexin sleep-wake control.

core: Regional neuronal differentiation in developing brain
name: Forebrain, retinal and cerebellar neuronal differentiation
rationale: Members concern fate commitment and differentiation in forebrain, thalamus, retina, cerebellum, substantia nigra and adenohypophysis; neighbours emphasize cortical migration, neuroblast division or spinal cord patterning.

Members mix Pol II transcription initiation, Polycomb chromatin, ribosome assembly, ubiquitination, centrosome/mitosis, RB1/BCL2L1 survival and mitochondrial housekeeping modules with no single shared biological theme.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, translational fidelity and anticodon-loop (wobble, t6A) modifications; neighbours carry mitochondrial translation, wybutosine/diphthamide or methylation/pseudouridylation.

name: Protein prenylation and lipidation of Rab and Ras
rationale: Members concern protein lipid modification, notably geranylgeranylation of RABs and RAS C-terminal processing; neighbours instead carry cysteine palmitoylation and Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation.

name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures
rationale: All members are monocyte or dendritic cell surface/enrichment modules; neighbours add CD1 antigen presentation, activated DC, T cell or plasma cell signatures.

name: Phospholipase C-gamma signaling downstream of FGF receptors
rationale: All three members are PLC-mediated cascades from FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4; neighbours hold the FRS, SHC, PI3K and ligand-binding branches of FGFR signalling.
